text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса and I are on our way
back after an
outing when her phone
goes off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This is bad, Trainer! This just dropped on
a
wrestling site...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Ellie Condra is retiring!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Why would she do this?! She still hasn't
proven
that she's the world's strongest!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure yet, but... it's a pretty
trustworthy fan
site.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I have to check with her myself! The
agency she
works with is close by, so
let's go!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Since it hasn't been officially stated, it's
unlikely
we'll get an answer even if we
ask directly.
However...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I just have to know!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: She's my rival!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm the only one who thinks so...
her
performance in the ring is what made
me feel that
way!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: So I just have to ask!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: ...All right! Thank you, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Ellie Condra isn't at her agency.
Apparently, she's
training for her next
match.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She left to go run by the riverside a bit
ago. As
for where she is now... Well...
text_block_list.name: Agency Staff

text_block_list.text:
I don't believe she has any plans to
come back
today. She also starts training
camp tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Agency Staff

text_block_list.text:
As for information regarding retirement,
that
should be made clear at her next
match. That's all
I can say, sorry.
text_block_list.name: Agency Staff

text_block_list.text: Is her next match... a farewell match?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Even though she's my rival, I'm also still
one of
her fans.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Even if I don't really have a choice, it
doesn't
make waiting till her next match
any easier...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The agency staff say that Ellie Condra
has just
left. Given that information...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Let's see if we can find her!
Let's see if we can catch up to her!

text_block_list.text: Th-that's a great idea!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: She might still be close, or by the river!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Vámonos, Trainer! Let's go!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We search until it gets dark, but
unfortunately,
we don't find her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming with me, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Even though we didn't find her...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
She seems a little down. I think about
how to
comfort her, but then I see the
look in her eyes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even if she gives up on her dream, I'm
not givin'
up on mine.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Not just her. Even if every last one of my
rivals
throws in the towel...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I'll keep soarin' no matter what!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'll take the passion and courage that all
of my
rivals have given me... and turn it
into power!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
She's passionate and full of fighting
spirit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That's true. Something terrible could
have forced
her to give up...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We'll find out at the next match! Let's
wait until
then!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's really late, huh? Let's go home,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That's right! They did say she just left!
Maybe we
can catch her!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Let's go to the riverside!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We make it to the riverside, but Ellie
Condra is
nowhere to be seen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Maybe she's a little further ahead! I'll
check over
that way!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We search around the area a bit more,
but we
can't find her. It's getting dark
out...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hmm... Let's try somewhere else!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: But we can't give up!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Ellie Condra said she was gonna prove
herself!
Just like me!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: Do you really think she's giving up?

text_block_list.text: Hmmm...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The conviction with which Ellie Condra
spoke
when we saw her at the station
was certainly no
lie.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That's right. She said she was gonna be
world
champion.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm so curious about her reasons, but I
believe
what she said that day!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I'll just do what I need to do to prove I'm the world's strongest!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
While I wouldn't say she's gotten over
the news,
El Condor Pasa sets off with
her eyes on the
future.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her smile looks a bit forced, but she's
still the
same Эль Кондор Паса, with her
eyes on the future.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
